title: How that Wasn't Ted | S2E4 "Ted Mosby: Architect"

sentences.en: My name's Cam.
sentences.zh: 我叫卡姆。

sentences.en: I'm from Astero, Florida.
sentences.zh: 我来自佛罗里达州阿斯特罗。

sentences.en: What does How I Met Your Mother mean to me?
sentences.zh: 《老爸老妈浪漫史》对意味着什么？

sentences.en: It means a lot, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实意义重大。

sentences.en: I started watching it early high school.
sentences.zh: 我上高中早期就开始看了。

sentences.en: I fell in love with it, man.
sentences.zh: 我真的爱上了这部剧，老兄。

sentences.en: Like, I've watched it ever since.
sentences.zh: 就像，我从那以后一直在看。

sentences.en: I'm in college now.
sentences.zh: 我现在上大学了。

sentences.en: I really resonated with a lot of the characters in the show, but mostly Ted and his music choices.
sentences.zh: 剧中的很多角色我都很有共鸣，但主要是泰德和他的音乐品味。

sentences.en: I noticed, you know, like a lot of the times when Ted falls in love, it's George Harrison will play.
sentences.zh: 我发现，你知道，很多时候当泰德坠入爱河时，都会播放乔治·哈里森的歌。

sentences.en: And, you know, he loves Otis Redding.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他很喜欢奥蒂斯·雷丁。

sentences.en: So sometimes like cigarettes and coffee will play.
sentences.zh: 所以有时会放《香烟与咖啡》。

sentences.en: It's like he had this soundtrack to his life.
sentences.zh: 就好像他的人生有这样一份原声大碟。

sentences.en: And I remember I showed up to my entrepreneurship class.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次我去上创业课。

sentences.en: They asked us, you know, what do you want to do with your life?
sentences.zh: 他们问我们，你知道，你想用你的人生做点什么？

sentences.en: I knew in that moment that it was music.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我知道，这就是音乐。

sentences.en: You know, I wanted to give people a soundtrack to their lives.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想给人们的人生配上一首原声音乐。

sentences.en: I wanted to help people.
sentences.zh: 我想帮助人们。

sentences.en: You know, it's the reason I started a record label this year.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是我今年创办唱片公司的原因。

sentences.en: You know, from the ground up, me and a bunch of people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从零开始，我和一群人一起。

sentences.en: A bunch of nerds about music.
sentences.zh: 一群热爱音乐的极客。

sentences.en: So I guess I love How I Met Your Mother for a lot of reasons, but it definitely taught me how to care about what you love and not be ashamed and nerd out about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我爱《老爸老妈浪漫史》有很多原因，但它绝对教会了我如何去在乎你所爱的事物，不要感到羞耻，并为之疯狂。

sentences.en: And if you surround yourself with the right people, they'll support it.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你身边都是对的人，他们会支持你的。

sentences.en: So hope this reaches you guys.
sentences.zh: 所以希望这段话能传达到你们那里。

sentences.en: Big fan of the show.
sentences.zh: 我是这档节目的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: Have a great day.
sentences.zh: 祝你们有个美好的一天。

sentences.en: To tell you everything in New York City.
sentences.zh: 向你讲述纽约市的一切。

sentences.en: Cam, I love that you singled out Otis Redding and Georgia Harrison and some of the coolest, like, timeless kind of classic people.
sentences.zh: 卡姆，我很高兴你特别提到了奥蒂斯·雷丁和乔治·哈里森，还有一些最酷的、那种永恒的经典人物。

sentences.en: That was sweet.
sentences.zh: 那感觉真好。

sentences.zh: 但也就是从那时起，我和你、还有安迪成了剧组里的音乐死党。

sentences.zh: 我们当时就像……

sentences.zh: 我们都是音乐迷。

sentences.en: We're exactly what Cam said.
sentences.zh: 我们完全就像卡姆说的那样。

sentences.en: And Andy started including me in the music drops.
sentences.zh: 然后安迪开始把我加进音乐分享群里。

sentences.en: He would give you like once a week, he would give you like an awesome playlist of like new music.
sentences.zh: 他差不多一周给一次，给你一份超棒的新音乐播放列表。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 然后你说，我也想加入那个群，因为我想听酷炫的新音乐。

sentences.zh: 找到酷炫的新音乐就是安迪·高恩的工作。

sentences.zh: 他做到了。

sentences.en: Okay, so this episode is also a mystery episode.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这一集也是一个充满谜团的一集。

sentences.en: It starts off with a WTF.
sentences.zh: 一开场就是一个满头问号。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.zh: 克雷格，给我们简单总结一下这一集发生了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: This episode is diving into Ted and Robin's early...
sentences.zh: 这一集深入探讨了泰德和罗宾早期的……

sentences.en: It's their first fight, right?
sentences.zh: 这是他们的第一次争吵，对吧？

sentences.en: This is their first big problem.
sentences.zh: 这是他们遇到的第一个大问题。

sentences.en: Robin thinks...
sentences.zh: 罗宾认为……

sentences.en: Robin doesn't know how to be in a couple.
sentences.zh: 罗宾不知道该怎么谈恋爱。

sentences.en: And she doesn't want to listen to Ted's work complaints, which of course is a huge part of being in a couple.
sentences.zh: 而且她不想听泰德抱怨工作上的事，而这当然是恋爱中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Is being able to complain and be complained to, and it's a two-way complaint street, and she just doesn't want to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 那就是能够抱怨以及听取别人的抱怨，这是一条双向的抱怨街道，而她就是不想应付这个。

sentences.en: She's kind of phoning in some aspects of what it takes to be in a couple.
sentences.zh: 对于维系一段感情所需要的付出，她有点在敷衍了事。

sentences.en: And the journey of the episode is her thinking that Ted has stormed off and is perhaps cheating on her, using his hot job as an architect as a way to do that.
sentences.zh: 这一集的心路历程是，她以为泰德一气之下摔门走了，可能还在对她不忠，利用他建筑师这份抢手的工作当作借口。

sentences.en: And it's...
sentences.zh: 而且它……

sentences.en: I like the journey for Robin in this one.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢罗宾在这一集里的心路历程。

sentences.en: She kind of realizes the stakes of being in a relationship and that you do have to go a little crazy.
sentences.zh: 她开始意识到恋爱是有风险的，而且你确实得为此付出一点疯狂的努力。

sentences.en: You do have to be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 你确实必须得展现出脆弱的一面。

sentences.en: And of course, there's a huge twist to Rue, and we read...
sentences.zh: 当然了，关于露丝有个巨大的反转，我们读到...

sentences.en: It's a classic How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 这是典型的《老爸老妈浪漫史》风格。

sentences.en: We see the story twice, kind of.
sentences.zh: 我们差不多看了两次这个故事。

sentences.en: We see the story one way that Robin's imagining it, and then the real way, which is that Barney is posing as Ted.
sentences.zh: 我们先是以罗宾想象的方式看了一遍，然后是真实的方式，也就是巴尼假装成泰德。

sentences.en: And it is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a mystery.
sentences.zh: 这是一个谜团。

sentences.en: Like, many a great How I Met Your Mother episode.
sentences.zh: 就像许多伟大的《老爸老妈浪漫史》剧集一样。

sentences.en: It's remarkable to me in this rewatch how many of these episodes are a little mystery within the larger mystery.
sentences.zh: 在这次重温中，我感到惊叹的是，这些剧集里有多少都在更大的谜团中包含了一个小谜团。

sentences.en: Like, every second or third episode is somehow a weird little mystery.
sentences.zh: 就像每两三集就会出现某种奇怪的小谜团。

sentences.en: Like, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 比如，到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: It's also, like, a time-honored narrative technique.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种历史悠久的叙事手法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, every chapter of Harry Potter ends with, like, a weird cliffhanger that makes you, like, absolutely have to turn the page.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，《哈利·波特》的每一章结尾都有那种奇怪的悬念，让你绝对不得不翻页。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I'm reading it out loud with my daughter right now, and we got to the cliffhanger, and she got so worked up, she had to run around the room.
sentences.zh: 我最近正和女儿大声朗读这本书，我们读到了那个悬念，她激动得不得了，不得不绕着房间跑。

sentences.en: She just ran around the room.
sentences.zh: 她就绕着房间跑。

sentences.en: I said to Rebecca, we were reading it all.
sentences.zh: 我对丽贝卡说，我们把整本书都读了。

sentences.en: We read it as a family.
sentences.zh: 我们全家一起读。

sentences.en: We switched off doing the voices.
sentences.zh: 我们轮流模仿不同的声音。

sentences.en: And Silly was like, ah!
sentences.zh: 然后西莉就喊：啊！

sentences.en: And, like, ran around the room because of what was going on.
sentences.zh: 因为发生的事情，就像那样绕着房间跑。

sentences.en: I said, Jesus, I want to write something someday that makes someone run around a fucking room.
sentences.zh: 我对她说，天哪，我希望有一天能写出能让人激动得绕着他妈的房间跑的作品。

sentences.en: Because she's nine years old.
sentences.zh: 因为她才九岁。

sentences.en: She's just like, ah!
sentences.zh: 她就觉得，啊！

sentences.en: She was running back.
sentences.zh: 她跑了回来。

sentences.en: Just had to throw off the energy.
sentences.zh: 只是不得不释放一下精力。

sentences.en: There was just too much.
sentences.zh: 情绪实在是太饱满了。

sentences.en: Yeah, she was like, I've got to get this out somehow.
sentences.zh: 对，她当时的心情就是：我得把这股劲儿发泄出来。

sentences.en: She knew she wasn't going to get to go past the cliffhanger.
sentences.zh: 她知道自己不能继续看下去越过那个悬念了。

sentences.en: She had to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 她得去睡觉了。

sentences.en: I mean, God bless it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真是谢天谢地。

sentences.en: If you can write something that does that kind of create...
sentences.zh: 如果你能写出那种能让人产生这种效果的作品...

sentences.en: I immediately said that.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就这么说了。

sentences.en: I said, I don't think I've ever written anything that would make someone run around the room like that.
sentences.zh: 我说，我觉得我从来没有写过什么东西能让人像那样绕着房间跑。

sentences.en: I did that with your book, Craig.
sentences.zh: 我读你的书时就是这样的，克雷格。

sentences.en: Thank you, Josh.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔什。

sentences.en: I kept interrupting the audio recording because I kept running around the booth.
sentences.zh: 我一直在打断音频录制，因为我一直在录音棚里跑来跑去。

sentences.en: And I wrote you this little ditty to sing to you in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我给你写了首小曲子，准备在纽约市唱给你听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，言归正传。

sentences.en: I just realized, I saw my friend, you know Michael Chernis, my friend Michael Chernis?
sentences.zh: 我刚刚意识到，我看到了我的朋友，你知道迈克尔·切尼斯吗，我的朋友迈克尔·切尼斯？

sentences.en: He's a great actor.
sentences.zh: 他是个很棒的演员。

sentences.en: He's on Severance.
sentences.zh: 他参演了《人生切割术》。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: He was on Origins New Black.
sentences.zh: 他演过《女子监狱》。

sentences.en: He's a longtime friend.
sentences.zh: 他是我的老朋友了。

sentences.en: We were in drama school at the same time together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起在戏剧学校学习。

sentences.en: And he, I saw him in a great play in Fort Greene.
sentences.zh: 我是在格林堡的一个很棒的戏剧里看到他的。

sentences.en: And the gist of the play was this man had died under very strange circumstances.
sentences.zh: 那部剧的大意是，这个男人在非常奇怪的情况下死去了。

sentences.en: And his wife, for most of the play, doesn't know how to grieve because they were so suspiciously weird.
sentences.zh: 在整部剧的大部分时间里，他的妻子都不知道该如何悲伤，因为他们实在是可疑地古怪。

sentences.en: And he was with this young college girl and she thinks he was having an affair.
sentences.zh: 而且他和一个年轻的女大学生在一起，她觉得他在出轨。

sentences.en: And the play is done, so I'm not going to even tell you what it is.
sentences.zh: 而且这剧已经演完了，所以我甚至不会告诉你这是什么剧。

sentences.en: But the reversal is, it turns out, he was actually being an extra good guy and someone else was having an affair with her.
sentences.zh: 但反转是，结果证明，他其实是个极好的好人，而另一个人在跟她出轨。

sentences.en: And it's revealed that he was actually like the person she thought he was.
sentences.zh: 并且剧情揭示出，他其实就是她想象中的那种人。

sentences.en: She spends the whole play wondering, who was I married to?
sentences.zh: 她整部剧都在纳闷：我嫁给了一个什么人？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then it turns out, oh, she was married to the great, beautiful, kind man that she thought she was married to.
sentences.zh: 然后真相大白，噢，她嫁的就是她以为自己嫁的那个伟大、美丽、善良的男人。

sentences.en: And I think that there's a lot of narrative techniques of, oh, the person you thought was good was actually had a heart of darkness.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有很多这种叙事手法：噢，你以为是个好人的人，其实内心深处黑暗无比。

sentences.en: And it's a journey into their secret life, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一场探索他们秘密生活的旅程，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's like a trope.
sentences.zh: 这就像是个老套路。

sentences.en: But there's something nice about that play and this one where it's like, no, he's actually who you think he is.
sentences.zh: 但这部剧和那部剧的精妙之处就在于，不，他其实就是你想象中的那种人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: This was a misunderstanding.
sentences.zh: 这只是一场误会。

sentences.en: This was, you know.
sentences.zh: 这只是，你知道的。

sentences.en: So the reveal, of course, is that everyone's saying, oh, Ted Mosby, architect, he was here.
sentences.zh: 所以剧情揭晓的时候，大家当然都在说，哦，泰德·莫斯比，建筑师，他来过这里。

sentences.en: And man, he was crazy and he was seducing everyone.
sentences.zh: 天哪，他太疯狂了，他在勾引每一个人。

sentences.en: And it turns out it's Barney wearing the costume of Ted, saying, I'm Ted Mosby, architect, and being Barney, but with this different cloak on.
sentences.zh: 结果证明那是巴尼穿着泰德的戏服，说：我是建筑师泰德·莫斯比。其实还是巴尼，只是披了件不同的外衣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it's Robin's willingness to go a little crazy and then realizing that is what it means to be in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 而且罗宾愿意稍微疯狂一下，然后意识到这才是身处一段关系中的意义。

sentences.en: You think you have that other person figured out.
sentences.zh: 你以为你把另一个人摸透了。

sentences.en: He's just going to come home and complain about work.
sentences.zh: 他回家只会抱怨工作。

sentences.en: And then it's revealed to you that everyone is a mystery, right?
sentences.zh: 然后真相向你揭示，每个人都是一个谜，对吧？

sentences.en: She goes down this rabbit hole of like, maybe I don't know this guy at all.
sentences.zh: 她陷入了一种钻牛角尖的状态，觉得：也许我根本就不了解这家伙。

sentences.en: And it does turn out to be a complete mislead, but it's a good lesson for her to learn.
sentences.zh: 结果证明这完全是个误导，但对她来说是个很好的教训。

sentences.en: Like, you don't have him figured out.
sentences.zh: 就像是，你根本没把他摸透。

sentences.en: You don't know everything about Ted.
sentences.zh: 你并不了解泰德的一切。

sentences.en: It's still early days in this.
sentences.zh: 这段关系还处于早期阶段。

sentences.en: And not only that, the thought that he might be straying and she might be losing him is really hard for her.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，一想到他可能会出轨、她可能会失去他，她就觉得非常难受。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it's like, it's almost like you, you, you don't know what, yeah, this is a cliche.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是，简直就像你，你，你不知道，对啊，这是个老生常谈。

sentences.en: You don't know what you got until it's gone, right?
sentences.zh: 得不到的永远在骚动，失去了才懂得珍惜，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, she, she starts, um, fantasizing about like, oh, he's, he's going away and I will be bereft.
sentences.zh: 就像她，她开始，呃，幻想说，哦，他，他要走了，而我会失去一切。

sentences.en: And therefore I have to, I have to, uh, I have to reconceive of who, who I am in a, in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 因此我必须，我必须，呃，我必须重新构想我在一段关系中到底是谁。

sentences.en: I think you guys were still really finding the Scherbatsky avoidant attachment style.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们当时还在摸索史巴斯基式的回避型依恋风格。

sentences.en: Like second season feels like you really dialed that in more.
sentences.zh: 第二季感觉你们真的把这个特质拿捏得更到位了。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是的。

sentences.en: I think that's the gift of a long running TV show.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是长寿电视剧的魅力所在。

sentences.en: You start to peel back the layers and I love, she starts the episode off so cocky and so kind of dismissive of, I don't have to do the bullshit of couplehood.
sentences.zh: 你开始剥茧抽丝，我好喜欢，她刚出场时那么傲慢，甚至有点不屑一顾，觉得我才不需要搞什么情侣之间的废话。

sentences.en: We'll just skip the bullshit part and we'll just do the fun parts.
sentences.zh: 我们直接跳过废话部分，只享受有趣的部分就行了。

sentences.en: You can't do that.
sentences.zh: 你不能那样做。

sentences.en: She, you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 她，你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: She just, that doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 她就是，那样行不通。

sentences.en: And real watching her spiral and become vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 而真正看她情绪失控并变得脆弱。

sentences.en: I really liked that moment and how Kobe played it where, where she says, I took the nicest guy in the world and I turned him into a cheater because I was, I took him for granted.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢那个时刻以及寇比的演绎，她当时说：我把世界上最好的人变成了一个作弊者，因为我，我把他的好当作理所当然。

sentences.en: She's wrong about that, but it's, it's important for her to take the hit on that one.
sentences.zh: 她在这点上想错了，但对她来说，勇敢承担这个过失是很重要的。

sentences.en: And, uh, I, I, that's, that's, you watch, you watch Robin grow in this one.
sentences.zh: 而且，我，我，你可以看到，你可以看到罗宾在这集里的成长。

sentences.en: You watch her learn something in this one, which I like.
sentences.zh: 你看着她在这集里学到了一些东西，我挺喜欢的。

sentences.en: I, I went to this, uh, these two men's retreats with this group called Everyman, E-V-R-Y-M-A-N.
sentences.zh: 我参加过这个，呃，由一个叫Everyman（全人类）的组织举办的两次男子静修营，拼写是E-V-R-Y-M-A-N。

sentences.en: If there are any men out there who are looking for more kind of like to drop into their feelings and, you know, lean in more to community, I can't recommend this highly enough.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何男性朋友在寻找那种更愿意袒露内心情感、你知道的、更融入社群的方式，我极力推荐这个。

sentences.en: But this group, I, you know, um, it spun off a weekly, uh, men's group that I do every Monday night.
sentences.zh: 但这个群体，我，你知道的，呃，它衍生出了一个每周的，呃，我每周一晚上都会参加的男士互助会。

sentences.en: And we do this thing called checking in, which, uh, I love very much.
sentences.zh: 我们会做一件事叫“签到”，呃，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: And Jordana loves it so much that we do it in my marriage, which is essentially you say, uh, Josh, checking in.
sentences.zh: 乔达娜也非常喜欢，以至于我们在婚姻里也会这样做，基本上就是你说，呃，“约什，签到”。

sentences.en: And you, uh, you say, um, you know, you describe what you're feeling physically and sensations.
sentences.zh: 然后你，呃，你会说，嗯，你知道的，你描述一下你身体的感受和生理反应。

sentences.en: I feel tightness at the top of my shoulders.
sentences.zh: 我觉得双肩有些紧绷。

sentences.en: I feel, uh, scratchiness in my throat.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，呃，喉咙有点刺痛。

sentences.en: I feel, um, uh, labor, uh, labored breathing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，嗯，呃，呼吸，呃，呼吸有点困难。

sentences.en: And then you say any emotions you're feeling.
sentences.zh: 然后你要说出你感受到的任何情绪。

sentences.en: I feel, uh, grateful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，呃，很感激。

sentences.en: I feel anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我感到焦虑。

sentences.en: I feel excitement about tonight.
sentences.zh: 我对今晚感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And, uh, and I feel, um, thirsty.
sentences.zh: 还有，呃，而且我觉得，嗯，口渴。

sentences.en: And then you say, I'm here and I'm in.
sentences.zh: 然后你要说：“我在这里，我心在此。”

sentences.en: And then the other person says, ah-ho, which is like a kind of Native American amen.
sentences.zh: 接着另一个人会说“阿豪”，这有点像美洲原住民语的“阿门”。

sentences.en: But we developed something where if you don't really want to check in, all you want to do is complain.
sentences.zh: 但我们开发了一种机制，如果你其实不想“签到”，只想发牢骚。

sentences.en: We call it, uh, kvetching in instead of checking in.
sentences.zh: 我们把这不叫“签到”，而叫“发牢骚”。

sentences.en: And so, so it was almost like, can I kvetch in?
sentences.zh: 所以，差不多就像是，“我能发个牢骚吗？”

sentences.en: And you say, yeah.
